cues.en: Thanks to this, the vast majority of the coffee sold here is,

cues.zh: 那是些老式设备，用来冲泡咖啡粉，不知为什么现在还能买到。而在 1939 年，我们本来就会用它们来煮咖啡，

cues.en: Get used to a thing which makes coffee all by itself, don't drink tea all that much, and an electric kettle becomes a niche item. Wait, I thought this video was about coffee makers. Anyway, in 1968

cues.zh: Paul Simon和Art Garfunkel问Joe DiMaggio去哪了。虽然Jolt和Joe已经离开远去，嘿嘿嘿，他1973年又出现了

cues.en: to hock Mr. Coffee.
cues.zh: 来给Mr. Coffee代言。

cues.zh: Mr. Coffee承诺在家就能喝到餐厅品质的滤泡咖啡。从不知道咖啡能这么好喝，煮得这么快。

cues.zh: 你看，十多年来，餐饮服务业一直在从渗滤壶转向篮式滤泡咖啡机，比如Bun O Matic。

cues.en: People really liked the taste of this new smoother brew,
cues.zh: 人们真的很喜欢这种更顺滑的新式咖啡的味道，

cues.zh: 我是说，如果你是那种有古怪水壶的人，你可能会用Melita滤泡器，市场上当然也有很多其他咖啡器具，但它们在很长一段时间内都无法撼动渗滤壶的主导地位，直到

cues.zh: Mr. Coffee出现。

cues.zh: 使用时，把咖啡粉放进滤纸，滤纸放在咖啡壶上方的冲泡篮里。

cues.en: It will then seep through, absorb all that caffeine and

cues.en: No longer recirculating

cues.zh: 倒掉咖啡渣后，只需冲洗一下咖啡壶和篮子就行了。

cues.en: Mr. Coffee sold like hotcakes and before long companies were copying it right and left.
cues.zh: Mr. Coffee 卖得火爆，没多久各公司就开始纷纷仿制它。

cues.en: The Mr. Coffee coffee maker didn't invent the concept of filter coffee, and it wasn't even the first electric drip brewer. That would be the Wagamat of Germany patented in 1954.
cues.zh: Mr. Coffee 咖啡机并没有发明滤泡咖啡的概念，甚至也不是第一台电动滴滤式咖啡机。那是德国 Wagamat 在 1954 年获得专利的机器。

cues.en: But Mr. Coffee popularized this brewing method in The US, and it more or less killed the percolator.
cues.zh: 但 Mr. Coffee 在美国推广了这种冲泡方式，也几乎干掉了渗滤式咖啡壶。

cues.en: However, a common feature of electric percolators would live on, the keep warm function.
cues.zh: 不过，电动渗滤壶的一个常见功能保留了下来：保温功能。

Yeah.

cues.zh: 那个盘子就安放在主底盘的上方。

cues.en: Here, electrical connections are at a terminal block in the back, and power is sent up to the switches at the front. In the middle of the chassis is a second shallow pan with a hole in its middle and a big curly q heating element spiraling inwards towards that hole.
cues.zh: 在这里，电气连接位于背面的接线端子上，电源则向上输送到正面的开关。机身中间是第二个浅盘，中间有个孔，还有一个盘旋向内延伸到该孔的大型盘管加热元件。

cues.en: When I saw this I thought
cues.zh: 当我看到这个时，我想

cues.en: this doesn't make any sense.
cues.zh: 这根本说不通啊。

cues.en: See, one of the things that the father of Mr. Coffee, Mr. Coffee senior I mean Vincent Murata was frightfully concerned with was the brewing temperature.
cues.zh: 你看，Mr. Coffee之父——我是说老Mr. Coffee Vincent Murata——极其关注的一件事就是冲煮温度。

cues.en: He thought boiling water was much too hot for good coffee, and since stovetop percolators percolated as a result of boiling,
cues.zh: 他认为沸水泡咖啡太烫了，而且既然炉灶式咖啡壶是通过沸腾来萃取咖啡的，

cues.en: well you couldn't get decent coffee out of them. He was convinced the water reaching the coffee should be 200 degrees Fahrenheit or about 93 Celsius,
cues.zh: 好吧，你根本用它们煮不出像样的咖啡。他坚信流到咖啡粉里的水温应该正好是华氏200度（约合93摄氏度），

cues.en: and no hotter and no colder.
cues.zh: 既不能更高，也不能更低。

cues.en: He obsessed over this, devising handmade prototypes which would automatically heat water to that precise temperature,
cues.zh: 他为此着迷，亲手设计出多个原型，能自动把水加热到那个精确的温度，

cues.en: and with his business partner Samuel Glaser and the help of engineer Edmund Abel Jr, a functional, mass producible Mr. Coffee was born.
cues.zh: 后来，他与商业伙伴Samuel Glaser以及工程师Edmund Abel Jr合作，一款可量产、能正常工作的Mr. Coffee诞生了。

cues.en: And I'm holding the patented mechanism right here.
cues.zh: 而我手里拿的正是这项专利机构。

cues.en: How in the heck is this thing controlling the water temperature?
cues.zh: 这东西到底是怎么控制水温的？

cues.en: I didn't have a clue so I looked at the original patent and what I found was a stroke of genius that I honestly can't believe works.
cues.zh: 我毫无头绪，于是去查了原始专利，结果发现了一个天才般的巧思，老实说我都不敢相信它居然能奏效。

cues.en: Consider that this heating element has an output power of a hair over 1,500 watts.
cues.zh: 想想看，这个加热元件的输出功率略高于1,500瓦。

cues.en: We could control it with some sort of thermostat but that's getting pretty involved for early nineteen seventies consumer goods.
cues.zh: 我们本可以用某种恒温器来控制它，但对上世纪七十年代初的消费品来说，那太复杂了。

cues.en: In operation,
cues.zh: 在实际运行中，

cues.en: this thing is just gonna run at full power, so how else could you control the water temperature?
cues.zh: 这东西就是全功率运转，那还能怎么控制水温呢？

cues.en: I suppose the size of this hole could be calibrated to let water through at precisely the right rate,
cues.zh: 我猜这个孔的大小可以校准，让水以恰到好处的速率通过，

cues.en: but that would only work with a specified inlet water temp, and there's too much variation in the real world for that to work.
cues.zh: 但那只在特定进水温度下才行得通，现实世界中的变化太多，这招不管用。

cues.en: Well, the answer was staring me in the face this whole time but I just didn't see it.
cues.zh: 答案其实一直就摆在我眼前，只是我没看出来。

cues.en: See what that hole is punched in? Why?
cues.zh: 看到那个孔是冲在什么上面的吗？为什么？

cues.en: It's a strip of metal. And what are strips of metal sometimes?
cues.zh: 它是一条金属片。而金属片有时候会是什么？

cues.en: Bi.
cues.zh: 双金属。

cues.en: That's right. This is a bimetallic strip.
cues.zh: 没错。这就是双金属片。

cues.en: If I use a torch lighter and throw some heat at it, you can see it bend away from the pan.
cues.zh: 我用喷枪点火器给它加热，你能看到它从锅底弯开。

cues.en: This dead simple arrangement of bimetallic strip and hole in pan is forming a thermostatic valve.
cues.zh: 双金属片和锅底小孔这种极其简单的结构，构成了一个恒温阀。

cues.en: In operation,
cues.zh: 在工作时，

cues.en: the heat from the heating element will cause this strip to bend away from the pan which lets water through more quickly.
cues.zh: 加热元件产生热量，会使双金属片向远离锅底的方向弯曲，从而让水更快地流过。

cues.en: That water, though, is cold and cools the strip back down so it begins to close again.
cues.zh: 然而，流过的水是冷的，会使双金属片冷却下来，于是它又开始闭合。

cues.en: These two counteracting forces combine to keep the water leaving the brewer at whatever our desired temperature happens to be. You can actually see this valve opening and closing as coffee is brewed through the water inlet.
cues.zh: 这两种相反的作用力结合在一起，使咖啡机流出的水保持在我们期望的温度。透过进水口，你甚至可以看到这个阀门在冲煮咖啡时开开关关。

cues.en: Pretty neat.
cues.zh: 挺有意思的。

cues.en: This set screw puts a bit of pressure on the bimetallic strip, allowing it to be calibrated,
cues.zh: 这个紧定螺丝对双金属片施加了一点压力，使其能够进行校准，

cues.en: which was presumably done at the factory before being boxed up.
cues.zh: 这 vermutlich（此处为自然语气，直译为：这大概是在出厂装箱前完成的）

cues.en: Now I did some testing to see just how close to 200 degrees Fahrenheit this thing was getting.
cues.zh: 我做了一些测试，看看这东西到底能达到接近 200 华氏度的程度。

cues.en: Not surprisingly,
cues.zh: 不出所料，

cues.en: it's not that close.
cues.zh: 其实没那么准。

cues.en: Actually towards the very end of the brew it was nearly spot on,
cues.zh: 事实上，在冲煮快结束时它几乎完全准确，

cues.en: but for the bulk of the brew it was wavering between about one seventy and one ninety.
cues.zh: 但在大部分冲煮过程中，温度一直在 170 到 190 度之间波动。

cues.en: The thermostatic valve works
cues.zh: 这个恒温阀能起作用，

cues.en: okay but it's not able to achieve a steady equilibrium as evidenced by the fact that it repeatedly opens and closes throughout the brew rather than settling in at a somewhat fixed position.
cues.zh: 但无法达到稳定的平衡状态，证据就是它在整个冲煮过程中不断地开开关关，而不是稳定在某个相对固定的位置。

cues.en: Each time the valve opened the output temperature would start to drop,
cues.zh: 阀门每次打开，出水温度就会开始下降，

cues.en: and once it closed the temperature rose again.
cues.zh: 一旦关闭，温度又会上升。

cues.en: But the world works in averages so I'm happy to call a 20 degree range pretty good.
cues.zh: 但世界是靠平均值运转的，所以我觉得20度的范围已经挺不错了。

cues.en: If you're wondering why the valve has that little hole in it, well that's simply there to keep water from pooling inside the machine and getting
cues.zh: 如果你好奇阀门上为什么有个小孔，那只是为了不让水在机器里积聚并变得

cues.en: nasty.
cues.zh: 恶心。

cues.en: A clever solution but which requires some quick starting action since,
cues.zh: 这是个巧妙的方案，但需要快速启动操作，因为

cues.en: as I learned the hard way, water will always flow through this. The instructions actually say that the coffee should be prepared in the basket and the machine switched on before you pour in the water.
cues.zh: 我吃过亏才知道，水总会从这儿流过。说明书上其实说，应该先把咖啡粉放进滤篮，倒水前先开机。

cues.en: Then you need to pour it in quickly and return the carafe to the base at once.
cues.zh: 然后你得迅速倒水，并立刻把咖啡壶放回底座。

cues.en: Basically,
cues.zh: 基本上，

cues.en: the coffee buys you some time as it absorbs the little bit of water that comes out first,
cues.zh: 咖啡会先吸收最先流出的一点水，从而帮你争取一些时间，

cues.en: but you don't have much before it's saturated and the brewed coffee falls out the hole in the bottom of the brew basket.
cues.zh: 但它很快就会饱和，煮好的咖啡会从滤篮底部的小孔流出来。

cues.en: So hurry up.
cues.zh: 所以赶紧。

cues.en: Calling this automatic
cues.zh: 管这叫自动

cues.en: is quite a stretch if you ask me.
cues.zh: 要我说，实在太牵强了。

cues.en: If you're thinking that the average consumer probably shouldn't be trusted with a 1,500 watt heating element sealed inside of a plastic shell, well, so are the designers of this as there is in fact a thermostat for the heating element.
cues.zh: 如果你觉得不该放心让普通消费者使用密封在塑料外壳里的1500瓦加热元件，那么这个产品的设计师也这么想，因为加热元件实际上配了温控器。

cues.en: But it's simply there to cut power to it when it runs dry.
cues.zh: 但它只是为了在干烧时切断电源。

cues.en: And that was also implemented quite cleverly.
cues.zh: 而且这一点实现得也很巧妙。

cues.en: The thermostat lives here,
cues.zh: 温控器在这儿，

cues.en: right below the hole in the water reservoir.
cues.zh: 就在水箱小孔的正下方。

cues.en: As the machine brews, cold water keeps landing on the thermostat,
cues.zh: 机器冲煮时，冷水会不断落在温控器上，

cues.en: ensuring the switch stays closed.
cues.zh: 确保开关保持闭合。

cues.en: But once it's out of water, well that cooling action no longer works and the heating element, through this bonding clip here, will quickly heat up the thermostat so it trips, cutting power and ensuring the coffee maker doesn't melt.
cues.zh: 但一旦离开水，这种冷却作用就不再有效，而加热元件会通过这里的连接夹迅速加热温控器，使其跳闸、切断电源，确保咖啡机不会熔化。

cues.en: Putting the thermostat right below the water inlet also helps ensure that the thermostat resets quickly if you want to brew another pot immediately after one just finished.
cues.zh: 把温控器放在进水口正下方，也有助于确保它快速复位——如果你想刚煮完一壶就马上再煮一壶的话。

cues.en: Pretty clever thinking.
cues.zh: 想得真巧妙。

cues.en: So now let's move on to the design refinement that would lead us to coffee makers like this one.
cues.zh: 现在让我们来看看设计改进，正是这些改进让我们有了像这样的咖啡机。

cues.en: At some point in the eighties, Mr. Coffee would ditch the thermostatic valve design in favor of a much simpler one.
cues.zh: 在八十年代的某个时候，Mr. Coffee 放弃了恒温阀设计，改用简单得多的方案。

cues.en: At first glance, this modern brewer may look more complicated.
cues.zh: 乍一看，这台现代咖啡机可能显得更复杂。

cues.en: Now water is at the back of the machine
cues.zh: 现在水箱在机器后部

cues.en: and it needs to be pumped up to the top to reach the coffee grounds.
cues.zh: 需要把水抽到顶部，才能到达咖啡粉。

cues.en: Pump sounds expensive.
cues.zh: 用泵听起来成本很高。

cues.en: But as it turns out, one method of pumping water requires just two things, a one way valve and a tube that gets hot.
cues.zh: 但事实证明，有一种抽水方法只需要两样东西：一个单向阀和一根会变热的管子。

cues.en: This arrangement is called a bubble pump, and it's almost devilishly simple as long time viewers of The Engineer Guy will know. That's two mentions in as many videos.
cues.zh: 这种装置叫气泡泵，简单得几乎不可思议——The Engineer Guy 的老观众会知道。这是连续两个视频里的第二次提到。

cues.en: We miss you, Bill.
cues.zh: 我们想念你，Bill。

cues.en: At the bottom of the water reservoir at the intake is a check valve.
cues.zh: 在水箱底部的进水处有一个单向阀。

cues.en: Water can flow downward through it but the valve prevents flow in the opposite direction. After
cues.zh: 水可以向下流过它，但阀门会阻止反方向流动。经过

cues.en: passing through the valve it ends up in this metal tube which contains the heating element.
cues.zh: 阀门后，水会进入这根装有加热元件的金属管。

cues.en: At the other end of that tube is some more tubing which leads up the back of the coffee maker and into the sprayer, where it will then fall onto the coffee.
cues.zh: 在那根管子的另一端还有一段管子，沿着咖啡机后部向上通到喷头，然后水会落到咖啡上。

cues.en: Passing electric current through the heating element, and thus making the tube containing the water frightfully hot, will quite quickly cause the small amount of water in there to boil.
cues.zh: 让电流通过加热元件，使装水的管子变得非常烫，这样很快就能让里面少量的水沸腾。

cues.en: Once it does, well, some of the water vaporizes and bubbles of water vapor form inside the tube.
cues.zh: 一旦沸腾，部分水会汽化，管子里就会形成水蒸气气泡。

cues.en: That increase in volume also increases the pressure inside the tube.
cues.zh: 体积增大也会让管内压力升高。

cues.en: The tube isn't sealed so it's not like it's gonna explode or anything, but the bubbles of water vapor need to go somewhere,
cues.zh: 管子并不是密封的，所以不会爆炸什么的，但水蒸气气泡总得有地方去，

cues.en: and since they're confined in a narrow tube,
cues.zh: 而它们又被限制在狭窄的管子里，

cues.en: they can only move by pushing water out of their way.
cues.zh: 只能把水推开才能移动。

cues.en: However, the check valve prevents the water from moving back into the reservoir.
cues.zh: 不过，止回阀会阻止水回流到水箱。

cues.en: That leaves the water with only one path to relieve the pressure, which is up this tube and out the sprayer.
cues.zh: 这样水就只剩一条路来释放压力：沿着这根管子向上，从喷头出去。

cues.en: Each little burst of water that leaves the sprayer was pushed out by bubbles of water vapor,
cues.zh: 从喷头出来的每一小股水，都是被水蒸气气泡推出来的，

cues.en: and once that slug of water is out, the pressure in the tube is relieved so cold water from the reservoir will now fall into the tube through the check valve and replace the water that just left.
cues.zh: 一旦这股水出去，管内压力就释放了，于是水箱里的冷水会通过止回阀进入管子，补上刚刚流走的水。

cues.en: That water then gets hot enough to boil, bubbles form, pressure increases, the valve closes, and another slug of hot water comes out the sprayer.
cues.zh: 然后这些水被加热到沸腾，气泡形成，压力升高，阀门关闭，又一股热水从喷头喷出。

cues.en: This process repeats over and over again, bubbles gurgling and the check valve clicking with each ingestion and expulsion of water.
cues.zh: 这个过程不断重复，每次吸水和排水时，气泡咕嘟咕嘟响，单向阀咔嗒作响。

cues.en: Since the heating element is in contact with such a small amount of water, the pumping action begins almost immediately.
cues.zh: 由于加热元件只接触这么少量的水，泵送动作几乎立刻就开始。

cues.en: Even with ice cold water in the tank there's only about a twenty second delay between switching the coffee maker on and hot water hitting the grounds.
cues.zh: 即使水箱里装的是冰水，从打开咖啡机到热水淋到咖啡粉上，也只有大约二十秒的延迟。

cues.en: It's only heating a few milliliters of water at a time, thus it nearly instantly starts to boil.
cues.zh: 它一次只加热几毫升水，因此几乎瞬间就开始沸腾。

cues.en: And with a constant supply of new water entering the boiling tube, the coffee maker continuously moves water through itself as it heats it.
cues.zh: 随着新水不断进入沸腾管，咖啡机在加热水的同时持续将水输送通过自身。

cues.en: The design just
cues.zh: 这个设计就是

cues.en: works.
cues.zh: 管用。

cues.en: It's amazingly effective for how simple it is.
cues.zh: 如此简单却出奇地有效。

cues.en: Since it moves water through itself by boiling it, that may make you wonder about the exit temperature.
cues.zh: 由于它通过煮沸来推动水，你可能会好奇出口温度。

cues.en: If Vince Murata was so concerned with brewing temp, why would he accept this design?
cues.zh: 如果 Vince Murata 那么在意冲泡温度，他为什么会接受这个设计？

cues.en: Truthfully,
cues.zh: 说实话，

cues.en: I don't know that he did, maybe he hated this cost cutting measure, but in practice the water that leaves isn't quite boiling.
cues.zh: 我不知道他是否接受了，也许他讨厌这种削减成本的做法，但实际上流出的水并不完全沸腾。

cues.en: A number of factors influence the exit temperature.
cues.zh: 出口温度受多种因素影响。

cues.en: You'll notice that in this machine the tube leaving the boilie bit down below travels through the cold water reservoir.
cues.zh: 你会注意到，在这台机器里，从下方沸腾部件引出的管子穿过冷水箱。

cues.en: That cools the water that travels up through it before it reaches the sprayer.
cues.zh: 这会在水到达喷头之前冷却向上流经管子的水。

cues.en: With my very definitely scientific testing equipment, I found that the brew starts at about 170
cues.zh: 用我那绝对科学的测试设备，我发现冲泡起始温度约为华氏170度

cues.en: Fahrenheit and slowly creeps up to about 190,
cues.zh: 然后慢慢升到约190度，

cues.en: probably as a result of the water level dropping and thus its cooling effect on the exit tube diminishing.
cues.zh: 可能是因为水位下降，从而对出口管的冷却效果减弱。

cues.en: There are probably other factors influencing this as well, such as the sprayer's shape and tubing diameter, and I imagine these were at one point tinkered with to produce a more or less ideal brew,
cues.zh: 可能还有其他因素影响这一点，比如喷淋头的形状和管道口径，我想这些肯定都曾被反复调试过，以达到相对理想的萃取效果，

cues.en: and you'll see why I think that shortly.
cues.zh: 稍后你就会明白我为什么这么认为了。

cues.en: But regardless, the exit temperature never quite reaches boiling.
cues.zh: 但不管怎样，出水温度从来都没真正达到沸点。

cues.en: Another interesting side effect of pumping by boiling is that the speed at which it does so is a function of how powerful the heating element is.
cues.zh: 靠沸腾抽水的另一个有趣现象是，它的抽水速度直接取决于发热元件的功率。

cues.en: And since brewing coffee shouldn't be done that fast anyway,
cues.zh: 既然煮咖啡本来就不该那么快，

cues.en: we don't actually want a very powerful heating element.
cues.zh: 我们其实并不需要功率太大的发热元件。

cues.en: If this were as powerful as one of those British kettles,
cues.zh: 如果它像那种英式电热水壶一样猛，

cues.en: it would push the 60 fluid ounces of a 12 cup coffee maker through in a little over three minutes, not enough time for a thorough brew.
cues.zh: 只要三分多钟，就能把 12 杯量咖啡机里的 60 液盎司水全推出去，根本来不及充分萃取。

cues.en: And yes, in coffee maker land, a cup is five fluid ounces just to be extra confusing.
cues.zh: 没错，在咖啡机的标准里，一杯其实就是 5 液盎司，纯粹是存心让人搞混。

cues.en: Now, to attain a more thorough brew, a much more reasonable heating element in the neighborhood of 900 watts is used.
cues.zh: 而为了更充分地萃取，采用 900 瓦左右的发热元件要合理得多。

cues.en: This coffee maker runs at about 850
cues.zh: 这台咖啡机的功率大约是 850

cues.en: watts,
cues.zh: 瓦，

cues.en: which slows it down to just under an eleven minute brew when making a full pot.
cues.zh: 煮满整壶需要不到 11 分钟，速度慢了不少。

cues.en: Now wait, I hear you say, didn't the original design pull 1,500 watts or so? Yes, and that's why I wanted to investigate it. As we've discussed previously,
cues.zh: 等等，你可能会问，最初的设计功率不是大概 1500 瓦吗？没错，这正是我想要一探究竟的原因。正如我们之前聊过的，

cues.en: energy is energy and water is water.
cues.zh: 能量就是能量，水就是水。

cues.en: More power means faster heating, so in theory the old design should make coffee faster than the new one.
cues.zh: 功率越大加热就越快，所以理论上老款煮咖啡应该比新款更快才对。

cues.en: And indeed,
cues.zh: 而事实上，

cues.en: this does brew coffee significantly
cues.zh: 这台机器煮咖啡确实明显

cues.en: faster than its great great great great grandson.
cues.zh: 比它的曾曾曾曾孙快得多。

cues.en: It took the new machine ten minutes and ten seconds to power through 50 ounces of water, but grandpa coffee only needed five minutes and forty two seconds to do the same.
cues.zh: 新机器花了 10 分 10 秒才处理完 50 盎司水，而爷爷辈的咖啡机只需 5 分 42 秒就搞定同样的量。

cues.en: Could it be that the older Mr. Coffee models brewed better coffee?
cues.zh: 难道是更老的 Mr. Coffee 型号煮的咖啡更好？

cues.en: Or perhaps is the longer brew an improvement?
cues.zh: 还是说更长的冲泡时间反而是一种改进？

cues.en: Naturally, I devised a taste test using otherwise identical setups. Same water, same coffee, same amount to the gram, same filters, and the same sweetening and creamening treatment between the same two mugs. And
cues.zh: 自然，我设计了一个品尝测试，其他条件完全相同。同样的水、同样的咖啡、精确到克同样的量、同样的滤纸，并且在同样的两个马克杯里做了同样的加糖和加奶处理。而且

cues.en: I I can't taste the difference. These taste exactly the same to me.
cues.zh: 我……我尝不出区别。这两杯对我来说味道完全一样。

cues.en: It's
cues.zh: 这感觉

cues.en: like I'm drinking two cups of the same coffee. Now I don't claim to have the most fosisticated
cues.zh: 就像我在喝两杯同样的咖啡。不过我不说自己有最讲究的

cues.en: taste, but I also don't wanna sell myself too short either.
cues.zh: 味觉，但我也不想太看轻自己。

cues.en: I start to notice a difference in my everyday coffee by about the third day after opening a new can, and it's whole bean coffee.
cues.zh: 一罐新咖啡打开后大约到第三天，我就能在日常喝的咖啡里察觉出不同，而且这还是全豆咖啡。

cues.en: By the time I'm at the end of the can, it's very different coffee. In fact, opening the next one is always a delightful experience. It's just so much better.
cues.zh: 等到快喝完一罐时，那已经是完全不同的咖啡了。事实上，打开下一罐总是件愉快的事。它就是好太多了。

cues.en: So, well, yeah. I'm not above a cup of Folgers now and again, I'm pretty sure I could at least notice some difference.
cues.zh: 所以，嗯，是啊。我也不排斥偶尔来一杯 Folgers，我挺确定自己至少能察觉出一些差别。

cues.en: But between these two coffee makers, I couldn't.
cues.zh: 但在这两台咖啡机之间，我察觉不出。

cues.en: Looking at some old Mr. Coffee models with the bubble pump design, I can see that those were also slowed down to the neighborhood of 900 watts.
cues.zh: 看看一些采用气泡泵设计的旧款 Mr. Coffee 型号，我能看出它们的功率也被降到 900 瓦左右。

cues.en: This suggests to me that with the change to bubble pump technology it required a slower brew to get the same brewing characteristics
cues.zh: 这让我觉得，改用气泡泵技术后，需要更慢的冲泡速度，才能获得相同的冲泡特性

cues.en: as the thermostatic valve design.
cues.zh: 就像恒温阀设计那样。

cues.en: However,
cues.zh: 不过，

cues.en: it may have also solved another problem.
cues.zh: 它可能还解决了另一个问题。

cues.en: Eagle eyed viewers may have noticed the coffee saver labeling on this brew basket.
cues.zh: 眼尖的观众可能注意到了这个冲泡篮上的 Coffee Saver 标识。

cues.en: This also intrigued me.
cues.zh: 这也引起了我的兴趣。

cues.en: The box claimed that this revolutionary new technology allowed you to save coffee when brewing smaller amounts as it helped maintain a uniform stack height no matter how many cups you were making.
cues.zh: 包装盒声称，这项革命性新技术让你在少量冲泡时也能节省咖啡，因为无论做几杯，它都能帮助保持均匀的咖啡粉堆高。

cues.en: See, changing the setting moves these little wing things into the center of the brew basket to keep the coffee stacked more vertically.
cues.zh: 你看，改变设置会把这些小翼状部件移到冲泡篮中央，让咖啡粉堆得更竖直。

cues.en: Pretty clever.
cues.zh: 挺聪明的。

cues.en: Apparently this feature was introduced during a coffee shortage.
cues.zh: 显然，这个功能是在咖啡短缺时期推出的。

cues.en: So I did another comparison, making four cups this time in both machines with the same otherwise identical setup as before save for this thing set to four cups.
cues.zh: 于是我又做了一次对比，这次两台机器都做四杯，除了把这个装置设成四杯外，其他设置和之前完全一样。

cues.en: And...
cues.zh: 结果……

cues.en: I feel like there is a difference, but it's very small.
cues.zh: 我感觉有差别，但非常小。

cues.en: Like, it's still... There's,
cues.zh: 就像，它还是……有，

cues.en: to me, hardly a perceptible difference between these two coffees.
cues.zh: 对我来说，这两杯咖啡几乎察觉不到差别。

cues.en: They both taste like Folgers.
cues.zh: 它们喝起来都像 Folgers。

cues.en: If this pinching brew basket did anything,
cues.zh: 如果这个会收拢的冲泡篮真起了什么作用，

cues.en: I would've expected the older machine's coffee to taste a little stronger,
cues.zh: 我本以为老机器的咖啡会味道更浓一点，

cues.en: but
cues.zh: 但

cues.en: nope. These were once again imperceptibly
cues.zh: 不。它们又一次难以察觉地

cues.en: different to me. And as a matter of fact, they seemed to taste exactly as they did when I brewed a larger quantity.
cues.zh: 对我来说不一样。而且事实上，它们的味道似乎和我冲泡更大份量时完全一样。

cues.en: However, it may still be the case that had I not pulled in the wing thingies here that this would have tasted weaker.
cues.zh: 不过，要是我刚才没把那个侧翼组件拉出来，这杯尝起来可能还是会淡一些。

cues.en: Perhaps the speed of the brew in the original design required more coffee for smaller amounts.
cues.zh: 也许原本设计里的萃取速度，让少量的咖啡需要更多的粉量。

cues.en: As a matter of fact, the instructions seem to suggest that's what the coffee saver feature was intending to fix.
cues.zh: 事实上，说明书似乎暗示这正是那个“咖啡节省”功能想要解决的问题。

cues.en: I'm still not ruling it out as nothing but a gimmick, but maybe there was something to it. And maybe it would turn out that simply slowing the brew down had the same effect.
cues.zh: 我还是没排除它纯属噱头的可能，但也许确实有点道理。说不定最后会发现，单纯把萃取速度放慢也能达到同样的效果。

cues.en: Honestly, I'm more than a little surprised I couldn't make out a difference between these two coffee makers.
cues.zh: 说实话，这两款咖啡机我居然喝不出区别，这让我感到相当意外。

cues.en: I was starting to doubt my senses quite frankly but I decided to do a third test,
cues.zh: 坦白说，我当时开始怀疑自己的感官了，但我决定进行第三次测试，

cues.en: This time with a small four cup coffee maker pitted against the large 12 cup machine.
cues.zh: 这次是用一台小型四杯咖啡机对阵大型十二杯机器。

cues.en: This time there was a noticeable difference to me. This one might be a touch
cues.zh: 这一次我感觉到了明显的区别。这台可能稍微

cues.en: stronger.
cues.zh: 浓一点。

cues.en: Yeah. This... I think this is very, slightly stronger,
cues.zh: 对。这……我觉得这杯非常、稍微浓了一点，

cues.en: a little bit more bitter.
cues.zh: 苦味也稍微多了一点。

cues.en: Yeah. I prefer this one, actually. This is a little bit better.
cues.zh: 对。其实我更喜欢这款。这款稍微好喝一点。

cues.en: The smaller machine had a slightly harsher brew with a stronger bite to it, perhaps extracting more acids.
cues.zh: 小型机器的咖啡口感稍微重了些，冲击力更强，也许是萃取出了更多的酸类物质。

cues.en: What caused that difference?
cues.zh: 是什么导致了这种差异？

cues.en: I dunno. It could be that the water in this one hits the coffee at a different temperature from that one.
cues.zh: 我不知道。可能是这台机器的水接触咖啡时的温度和那台不同。

cues.en: It could be that the filter basket is smaller in this one. It could be that the small machine is slightly slower, or it may have been that its markings on the pot weren't as accurate and the total water used was different.
cues.zh: 可能是这台的滤篮比较小。可能是小型机器的速度稍微慢一些，又或者是它壶身上的刻线不够精准，导致实际使用的总水量不一样。

cues.en: Yes I know I should have used a beaker or something but the important thing is I detected a difference.
cues.zh: 我知道我本该用烧杯什么的，但重要的是我检测出了差异。

cues.en: It was slight but I detected it. So I think I can safely say these two large machines make practically identical coffee.
cues.zh: 差异很小，但我确实检测到了。所以我可以有把握地说，这两台大机器做出来的咖啡实际上几乎一模一样。

cues.en: Anyway,
cues.zh: 总之，

cues.en: we got way off track.
cues.zh: 我们跑题太远了。

cues.en: Let's talk about the hot plate again.
cues.zh: 再来说说加热盘。

cues.en: As we saw in the early Mr. Coffee machines,
cues.zh: 就像我们在早期 Mr. Coffee 咖啡机上看到的那样，

cues.en: the hot plate was added on separately from the core brewing function.
cues.zh: 加热盘是独立于核心冲泡功能额外加上去的。

cues.en: But as competition heated up and costs demanded getting cut,
cues.zh: 但随着竞争加剧、成本又必须削减，

cues.en: a very elegant refinement was made.
cues.zh: 一项非常巧妙的改进出现了。

cues.en: Modern designs use the same heating element for both the brewing part and the keeping warm part.
cues.zh: 现代设计让冲泡部分和保温部分共用同一个加热元件。

cues.en: The tube which heats the water for brewing
cues.zh: 用来加热冲泡用水的管子

cues.en: just so happens to be bonded to the bottom of the hot plate.
cues.zh: 恰好粘合在加热盘底部。

cues.en: Since metal's generally quite good at conducting heat through itself, a single heating element can perform both the brewing and the keeping warm functions.
cues.zh: 由于金属通常很善于传导热量，单个加热元件就能同时完成冲泡和保温两项功能。

cues.en: Now,
cues.zh: 现在，

cues.en: you might think this is a problem.
cues.zh: 你可能会觉得这是个问题。

cues.en: watts is a lot of power for such a small surface, especially one surrounded by plastic.
cues.zh: 瓦的功率，对这么小的表面来说太大了，尤其是周围还包着塑料。

cues.en: However, while brewing,
cues.zh: 不过，在冲泡时，

cues.en: the heat produced by that element gets absorbed into the water.
cues.zh: 那个元件产生的热量会被水吸收。

cues.en: If you've seen, oh I don't know, any of my videos you may remember that it takes a lot of energy to boil a liquid which we call the say it with me now
cues.zh: 如果你看过——呃，我不知道——我任何一个视频，你可能记得，煮沸液体需要大量能量，我们称之为——跟我一起说——

cues.en: latent heat of vaporization.
cues.zh: 汽化潜热。

cues.en: So long as there's water in this tube, the tube can't get any hotter than the boiling point of water. It's not physically possible.
cues.zh: 只要这根管子里还有水，管子的温度就不可能超过水的沸点。这在物理上是不可能的。

cues.en: Once it's done brewing and there's no more water in that tube, though...
cues.zh: 但一旦煮完咖啡，管子里没水了……

cues.en: Well,
cues.zh: 那么，

cues.en: now we have a problem.
cues.zh: 麻烦就来了。

cues.en: After boiling off what little water remains in a nice loud steam fest, the hot plate will quickly become a way too hot plate unless we cut the power to it.
cues.zh: 在伴随着一阵响亮的蒸汽声烧干仅存的水分后，除非切断电源，否则加热盘很快就会变得过热。

cues.en: So that's what we do. A thermostat set just a wee bit higher than the boiling point of water is bonded to the hotplate right here and wired in with the heating element.
cues.zh: 所以我们正是这样做的。一个设定温度略高于水沸点的温控器贴在加热盘的这个位置，并与发热元件串联。

cues.en: Once it's out of water and the hotplate eeks too far beyond the boiling point, the thermostat will open with a click breaking the connection and keeping the hotplate from melting the coffee maker.
cues.zh: 一旦水烧干，加热盘温度明显超过沸点，温控器就会“咔哒”一声断开电路，防止加热盘熔化咖啡机。

cues.en: This thermostat has essentially the same job as the safety thermostat in the old design,
cues.zh: 这个温控器的作用本质上和旧设计中的安全温控器相同，

cues.en: but by incorporating it in this way it can do double duty as a temperature regulator for the hotplate.
cues.zh: 但通过这种接入方式，它还能兼作加热盘的调温器。

cues.en: Once it cools off the circuit will close again for a brief while, bringing the hotplate back into the territory of hot.
cues.zh: 一旦冷却下来，电路又会短暂闭合，让加热盘重新保持温热。

cues.en: That clicking and heating and heating and clicking will repeat again and again and again and again.
cues.zh: 这种“咔哒”、加热、加热、“咔哒”的过程会一遍又一遍地不断重复。

cues.en: That is until you shut off the coffee maker or its auto off feature kicks in, if it has one. Now, you may have already noticed something about this design.
cues.zh: 直到你关掉咖啡机，或者它的自动关机功能（如果有的话）起作用。现在，你可能已经注意到了这种设计的特点。

cues.en: It's absurdly simple, and that means it's absurdly cheap to manufacture.
cues.zh: 它极其简单，这也意味着制造成本极其低廉。

cues.en: The original Mr. Coffee, without all these cost refinements,
cues.zh: 最初的 Mr. Coffee 没有经过这些成本精简，

cues.en: retailed for $39.99
cues.zh: 零售价为 39.99

cues.en: dollars in 1972,
which is equivalent to nearly $300
cues.zh: 相当于现在的

cues.en: today.
cues.zh: 近 300 美元。

cues.en: But people were gladly willing to pay that much because percolators were slow and made terrible coffee. It's the fastest coffee maker you can buy, with a patented system that gives you perfectly brewed coffee in seconds.
cues.zh: 但人们还是乐意花那么多钱，因为滤泡壶速度慢，而且煮出来的咖啡很难喝。这是你能买到的最快的咖啡机，拥有专利系统，几秒钟就能为你冲煮出完美的咖啡。

cues.en: Coffee that tastes better than percolated.
cues.zh: 味道比滤泡咖啡更好的咖啡。

cues.en: This was, at one point,
cues.zh: 这在当时，

cues.en: very fancy. Once you taste this,
cues.zh: 非常高级。一旦你尝了这个，

cues.en: you'll know why Mr. Coffee is the number one selling drip coffee maker. However,
cues.zh: 你就会明白为什么Mr. Coffee是最畅销的滴滤咖啡机。然而，

cues.en: as the design was refined over the years and manufacturing got cheaper for
cues.zh: 随着多年的设计改进以及制造成本变便宜，

cues.en: reasons,
cues.zh: 原因嘛，

cues.en: well drip machines got cheap pretty fast.
cues.zh: 滴滤机很快就变得很便宜了。

cues.en: These days a basic one like this will set you back a whole,
cues.zh: 如今，像这样的一台基础款只需花你大概，

cues.en: like, $20.
cues.zh: 呃，20美元。

cues.en: And if you're willing to stoop to Walmart store brand, you can get one for slightly less than 10.
cues.zh: 如果你愿意屈尊买沃尔玛的自有品牌，不到10美元就能买到一个。

cues.en: Well okay, 13 if you want a full size 12 cup machine, but this one is still under $10.
cues.zh: 好吧，如果你想要全尺寸的12杯咖啡机是13美元，但这台依然不到10美元。

cues.en: This is an older rival branded model but it's clearly the same machine, and I actually use this here at the studio and wouldn't you know it, it makes pretty good coffee.
cues.zh: 这是一个老对手品牌的型号，但显然是同一台机器，我实际上在工作室里就用这个，你猜怎么着，它煮的咖啡还不错。

cues.en: Is it an excellent cup of coffee?
cues.zh: 它算是一杯极品咖啡吗？

cues.en: No.
cues.zh: 不算。

cues.en: Far from it. But there are only so many things I'm willing to become an enthusiast for, and coffee ain't one of them.
cues.zh: 远算不上。但我愿意为之成为狂热爱好者的东西有限，咖啡可不在其中。

cues.en: There are hacks and techniques some people will go through to make these machines better, and there are plenty of people who would never ever stoop to this level.
cues.zh: 有些人会通过各种小技巧和方法来改进这些机器，也有很多人永远都不会屈尊使用这种级别的设备。

cues.en: But taste is among the most subjective things.
cues.zh: 但口味是最主观的事情之一。

cues.en: I have gone through the rigamarole and spent many hours experimenting
cues.zh: 我经历过那些繁琐的折腾，花了大量时间

cues.en: with different gadgets, among them the Aeropress,
cues.zh: 去尝试各种器具，其中包括 Aeropress、

cues.en: a French press, manual pour over cones, two different percolators,
cues.zh: 法压壶、手冲滤杯、两款不同的渗滤壶，

cues.en: yuck, a few K Cup and other single serve machines,
cues.zh: 呃，还有几台 K Cup 和其他单杯咖啡机，

cues.en: and several other drip machines across as wide a cost spectrum as a Midwesterner will tolerate,
cues.zh: 以及几台价格跨度大到中西部人能忍受极限的滴滤机，

cues.en: but I keep coming back to the same conclusion.
cues.zh: 但我最终总会得出同一个结论。

cues.en: I found a coffee I really like, I grind it the same every day, and it goes in this cheap bit of plastic without any fiddling or mental anguish and the result is to me a fine cuppa joe.
cues.zh: 我找到了自己真心喜欢的咖啡豆，每天按同样的粗细研磨，放进这个廉价的塑料小玩意里，省心省力，煮出来的对我来说就是一杯极好的咖啡。

cues.en: However, the one piece of advice I will give regarding these coffee makers, and I've said this before, is that if you are leaving it on to keep the coffee warm,
cues.zh: 不过，关于这类咖啡机我有一条建议，我之前也说过：如果你一直开着它来保温，

cues.en: you are ruining the coffee in the carafe. Don't do that.
cues.zh: 那你就是在毁掉壶里的咖啡。千万别这么做。

cues.en: I know. It's tempting, and after all,
cues.zh: 我知道这很诱人，而且说到底，

cues.en: that's what it's designed to do. But you really ought to shut it off when it's done brewing. If you're late to your second
cues.zh: 它的设计初衷就是如此。但煮完后你真应该直接关掉它。如果你隔了一阵才喝第二杯、

cues.en: or third
cues.zh: 第三杯、

cues.en: or fourth cup, I promise it's gonna taste so much better if you just throw it in the microwave for a bit to warm it back up.
cues.zh: 甚至第四杯，我向你保证，直接放进微波炉热一下，味道会好得多。

cues.en: I'm of the belief that a lot of the bad feelings towards these coffee makers come from the terribly burnt flavor the coffee will develop within just a few minutes of being left on.
cues.zh: 我一直认为，大家对这类咖啡机的反感，大多来自于保温状态下几分钟内就会产生的焦苦味。

cues.en: Again,
cues.zh: 所以，

cues.en: don't do it.
cues.zh: 千万别保温。

cues.en: I also value how easy these are to use. It's just get a filter, put it in the brew basket
cues.zh: 我也很看重它们用起来有多省事。只要拿张滤纸放进滤篮，

cues.en: then add your coffee, put water in the thing, and turn it on.
cues.zh: 加上咖啡粉，倒上水，然后开机就行了。

cues.en: Just wait a few minutes and coffee happens.
cues.zh: 只需等上几分钟，咖啡就煮好了。

cues.en: I do care enough to measure the amount of coffee I use with a skill, and even then it only takes about ninety seconds including grinding beans to get the coffee started. I could probably do it in less than a minute if I weren't,
cues.zh: 我还是挺讲究的，会特意称量咖啡用量，即便如此，算上磨豆也只要大约90秒就能开煮。要不是因为我……

cues.en: you know, waiting for coffee.
cues.zh: 你懂的，正眼巴巴等着咖啡提神呢，我可能不到一分钟就能搞定。

cues.en: You might not think this is the best way to make coffee but these sure are consistent at least.
cues.zh: 你可能觉得这不是做咖啡的最佳方式，但至少它的出品非常稳定。

cues.en: Because this process is so simple it's hard to screw it up. There might be subtle differences from machine to machine, particularly with how hot the water reaching the grounds actually is.
cues.zh: 因为这个过程太简单了，想搞砸都难。不同机器之间可能会有细微差异，尤其是冲到咖啡粉上的水温究竟有多高。

cues.en: Depending on the shape and size of the heating tube and of course the rest of the tubing, the exit temperature could be different between models and that will affect taste.
cues.zh: 取决于加热管的形状、尺寸以及其余管道的构造，不同机型的出水温度可能会有所不同，这会影响口感。

cues.en: I can't say I've noticed too much variation myself quite honestly but again I don't claim to have very sophisticated taste.
cues.zh: 说实话我自己没察觉出太大差别，不过我也没标榜过自己的味蕾有多挑剔。

cues.en: Another benefit of the simplicity here is that these machines tend to be quite reliable,
cues.zh: 结构简单的另一个好处是，这些机器往往相当耐用，

cues.en: typically only needing a descaling every now and then. I just run vinegar through it as needed.
cues.zh: 通常只需要偶尔除一次水垢。我有需要时就用白醋过一遍机器。

cues.en: However I have noticed an increasingly common problem as these age.
cues.zh: 不过我注意到，随着使用年限增长，有一个问题越来越常见。

cues.en: The thermostats controlling the hotplate seemingly drift with time and start getting too sensitive, tripping in the middle of a brew.
cues.zh: 控制保温盘的温控器参数似乎会随时间漂移，变得过于灵敏，在冲煮中途就会跳闸断开。

cues.en: This doesn't mean it won't make coffee but it can slow it down tremendously.
cues.zh: 这倒不至于做不出咖啡，但会极大地拖慢整个过程。

cues.en: When working properly, the thermostat should keep the heating element switched on until it's completely out of water,
cues.zh: 正常工作时，恒温器应让加热元件保持通电，直到水完全烧干，

cues.en: but if it becomes a little too sensitive it'll start clicking off during the brew, periodically pausing the process.
cues.zh: 但如果它变得过于敏感，就会在冲泡过程中开始咔哒一声断电，周期性地暂停整个流程。

cues.en: That can easily double the time it takes to make the pot which is annoying.
cues.zh: 这很容易让煮一壶咖啡的时间翻倍，很烦人。

cues.en: It might also result in an over extracted brew but frankly
cues.zh: 这也可能导致过度萃取，但说实话

cues.en: I've never noticed that.
cues.zh: 我从没注意到过。

cues.en: I have solved this by descaling the machine, suggesting a layer of calcium deposits within the tube insulated the water a bit from the heating element's heat so the thermostat got too hot.
cues.zh: 我通过给机器除垢解决了这个问题，推测是管内的一层钙质沉积物把水与加热元件的热量隔开了一些，导致恒温器过热。

cues.en: But getting rid of that layer of scale hasn't always worked, and I've gotten rid of a couple of slow coffee makers in the past.
cues.zh: 但清除那层水垢并不总是奏效，过去我已经淘汰过好几台慢吞吞的咖啡机了。

cues.en: So far, though, they've always been four cup machines. It's never happened to a big one.
cues.zh: 不过到目前为止，它们都是四杯机。大机器从没出过这问题。

cues.en: Anyway,
cues.zh: 总之，

cues.en: I think I've gone on long enough.
cues.zh: 我觉得我已经说得够久了。

cues.en: I am a vociferous defender of the humble drip brewer because it's simple, it's effective, it's cheap, it's reliable,
cues.zh: 我是 humble drip brewer 的坚定捍卫者，因为它简单、有效、便宜、可靠，

cues.en: and it's fairly good at what it does.
cues.zh: 而且在它该做的事情上相当出色。

cues.en: As with most things,
cues.zh: 和大多数事情一样，

cues.en: yeah you can optimize your experience to your heart's content,
cues.zh: 没错，你可以尽情优化你的体验，

cues.en: and if you have fun doing that,
cues.zh: 如果你乐在其中，

cues.en: by all means, have some fun. That's important.
cues.zh: 那就尽管去享受吧。这很重要。

cues.en: But,
cues.zh: 但是，

cues.en: well, what I'm optimizing for is the effort to flavor ratio and there's a pretty strong bias towards keeping the effort part low.
cues.zh: 嗯，我所优化的是努力与风味的比值，而且强烈倾向于让努力那部分保持低。

cues.en: I really liked the coffee that I got from my AeroPress and I will happily admit it was better than what these can make,
cues.zh: 我真的很喜欢我的 AeroPress 做出来的咖啡，我也乐于承认它比这些机器做的好喝，

cues.en: but that thing was just way too fiddly.
cues.zh: 但那玩意儿实在太繁琐了。

cues.en: I found my sweet spot with these things and I'm sticking to them.
cues.zh: 我找到了最适合自己的那套方法，就坚持用下去了。

cues.en: I do eventually need to try a moka pot though.
cues.zh: 不过最终我还是得试试摩卡壶。

cues.en: I wonder where I can find one of those....
cues.zh: 不知道去哪儿能找到一个……

cues.zh: 普通杂货店就有卖的。
